title: CompanyConnect
description:
This class defines the fields present in the `company_connect` object in
the link token.

For non-Company Connect link tokens, this field is optional. If the object
is present, it indicates that the link token is a Company Connect link
token.

Attributes:
    company_connection_id (UUID): This field specifies the ID of the
        company connection. This ID is generated by Pinwheel. All Company
        Connect webhooks reference the connection by this ID, and all
        public CC API endpoints require this ID as well.
